prerequisites: It is recommended that students have completed the subject Mathematics II of Technological Baccalaureate.

learning_outcomes.text: Ability to solve mathematical problems that may arise in engineering. Aptitude to apply knowledge on: linear algebra; geometry; differential geometry; differential and integral calculus; differential and partial differential equations; numerical methods; numerical algorithms; statistics and optimization.

syllabus_topics: Topic 1. Systems of linear equations, matrices, and determinants.
Topic 6. Real numbers and complex numbers.
Topic 7. Limits and continuity of real functions of a real variable.
Topic 8. Differentiation of real functions of a real variable. Applications.
Topic 9. Integration of real functions of a real variable. Applications.

assessment_methods.method: Problem-solving assignment to be submitted through the Virtual Classroom

assessment_rules: The final grade is the weighted average of the assessment activities, provided the minimum grade for each activity has been met. To pass, the weighted average must be at least 5. If one or more activities do not meet the minimum grade (3 for written exams), the final grade will be the average of all activities but cannot exceed 4.9. In the extraordinary resit, students must retake tests where the minimum grade was not achieved and may optionally retake those where the minimum was met but a pass was not obtained. The problem-solving assignment is not re-evaluable in the extraordinary resit.
